neighbours.label: an adjective piece in histopathology description: tissue-structure terms such as glomerular, extracellular, occlusive, endothelial in microscopic findings
fire: Microscopy showed thickening of the glomerular basement membrane and mesangial expansion.
The tumour cells secrete enzymes that break down the extracellular matrix of the surrounding stroma.
Sections of lung revealed occlusive intimal lesions in the small pulmonary arteries.
Renal biopsy demonstrated segmental sclerosis with glomerular capillary collapse.
Deposits of extracellular amyloid material were seen along the vessel walls.
Histologically, the arterioles displayed medial hypertrophy and endothelial proliferation.
Light microscopy revealed tubular atrophy, interstitial fibrosis and glomerular hypercellularity.
The lesion shows degradation of the extracellular collagen network of the alveolar wall.

The patient takes two tablets every morning to lower his blood pressure.

The clinic offers flu vaccinations every autumn without an appointment.

notes: Card and look mix two things: tissue adjectives in pathology text ('glomer|ular', 'extr|acellular', 'oc|clusive') and NBA game text (' Derek' Fisher, 'on the perimeter'). Probes: glomerular 0.90, extracellular matrix 0.54, 'and endothelial hyperplasia' 0.47, occlusive 0.39, but 'Intracellular calcium' 0.07; Derek Fisher in a Lakers sentence 0.70 while four other NBA sentences stayed under 0.16 and non-NBA names 0.00-0.04. I test the pathology half only; the basketball half is unexplained.
